column1: # MyBatis mapper counters (the XML mapper files of MyBatis): one per line, label TAB
# pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks comments, processing instructions and the DOCTYPE,
# but not CDATA: a mapper writes its SQL in CDATA, and its #{} parameters and ${} substitutions are
# what the counters read. A region that is never closed runs to the end of the file. "dynamic SQL
# <bind>; a ${} substitution is spliced into the SQL unescaped, which a reader of the index wants to
# find. A #{ or ${ counts up to its } on the same line, without another { before it. EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every
[ignore] comments, processing instructions and the DOCTYPE
